description:
Make `jit issue claim` append `IssueClaimed` only when the assignee changes, the same rule `claim acquire` and `issue assign` follow.

## Background

`jit issue claim` (lifecycle `Claim`, `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:3158-3168`) pushes `IssueClaimed` unconditionally, including when a Ready issue already assigned to the claimant is promoted and the assignment does not change. `issue assign` emits it only when the assignee changes (`commands/mod.rs:1600-1611`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `issue claim` appends `IssueClaimed` exactly when the assignee changes; a same-assignee promotion appends only the state change, and a test pins it.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Issue claim emits its event exactly when the assignee changes
